caption: The drawing depicts a decorative, crown-shaped panel with three points, rendered on a light tan background. The panel is embellished with detailed floral designs, including red bell-shaped and round flowers, white star-shaped flowers, yellow sprigs, and green leaves of varying shapes and sizes. The red flowers have a gradient of pink and darker red shading with white highlights and central yellow details. The green leaves vary in size and are depicted with brush strokes to show veins and form. The white flowers have yellow centers, and the yellow sprigs appear in groups of small stems and buds. The panel edges are outlined with a thin purple-blue line, and the floral arrangements are distributed across each of the three points, with a denser cluster at each peak and in the center. The background of the image is a pale, off-white color with scattered light brown stains.
